AGENDA
  SPECIAL BLUE RIBBON PENSION REVIEW COMMITTEE
  VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices
using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings are also
archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818) 548-4013 for
program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk's Office.
If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the
Management Services Department at (818) 548-4844, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM
110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  SEPTEMBER 29, 2021 AT 4:00 PM

To help slow the transmission of COVID-19, and protect the health and safety of the community, City
Council, as well as Board & Commission meetings, will continue to be closed to the public for in-
person attendance.

The public is encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social
distancing. Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and
AT&T U-verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's
webpage, glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon
Fire devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu.
 For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a
specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed.

  ROLL CALL

  a. Member Introductions

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  BLUE RIBBON PENSION REVIEW COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES

  September 29, 2021

ROLL CALL

Meeting starts at 4:13pm.

Present: Amirian, Bain, Kedikian, Knights, Manning, Masias, Michals, Molano, Nelson,
Wolfson, Finch, Wenz, Palos

Staff: Holtzman, Garcia, Takhtalian, Hayrapetian, Hovsepian, Doyle, Flynn, Martin,
Pagliassotto

1. REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. Ms. Hayrapetian reported that The
  Agenda for the October 4, 2021 Special Meeting of the Blue-Ribbon Pension
  Review Committee was Posted on October 1, 2021, on the Bulletin Board
  Outside City Hall.

2. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Member Introductions
Committee members and staff introduce themselves.

3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  None
4. CONSENT ITEMS
  None
5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Committee Purpose
  i. Discuss Council’s Direction
Holtzman reviews Staff Report to Council requesting the creation of a pension
committee and describing its intended purpose and structure.

  b. Rules of Order and Procedure
  i. Review and discuss Rules of Order and Procedures
Holtzman reviews the draft Rules of Order and Procedures.

Kedikian asks question about conflict-of-interest provision. Garcia explains that under
FPPC, having employees involved is not a conflict of interest. Wolfson expresses
concern about having a facilitator and Executive Committee vis-à-vis transparency of
information reported to Council. Michals requests clarification regarding process by
which committee members can request for

  1
 information outside of Executive Committee. Holtzman clarifies that, as written, the
Rules hold that items can be placed on the agenda by the Facilitator, Executive
Committee, and/or a majority of the Committee, and that any committee member can
bring an item to the Executive Committee for consideration. Molano suggests starting
without an Executive Committee. to see if we can get on without it
Kedikian expresses concern about the Executive Committee vis-a-vis the ability of
committee members to get items on agenda. Manning asks if there will be a section in
every agenda for getting items on future agendas. Holtzman answers in the affirmative:
all agendas will have a section for placing items on future agendas. Holtzman
expresses that his intention regarding the Executive Committee is to have some folks
he can talk to in some detail about how to be sure that he is presenting all of the
information and issues that will address the concerns of the largest number of people.
He explains that the purpose of the Executive Committee is to help focus the
conversation and talk through agenda items. He adds that the Brown Act limits what can
be communicated while offline.

The committee members and staff discuss concerns over the Rules of Order and
Procedure as written, including: the Executive Committee, how items will be placed on
agendas, the December 2021 deadline, the timing and schedule for meetings, Robert’s
Rules of Order, the Brown Act and communications outside of meetings.

Holtzman motions to amend the Rules of Order and Procedure as follows: (i) expand
the Executive Committee to 5 members, (ii) move language about committee members’
power to place items on agendas to the agenda section of the Rules, (iii) add that the
Executive Committee would report on items that were proposed for agenda but rejected,
(iii) that the Secretary will call items rather than the Presiding Officer

Kedikian seconds the motion.
Ayes: Amirian, Bain, Kedikian, Manning, Masias, Michals, Molano, Nelson, Wolfson,
Finch, Wenz, Zakarian, Palos
Noes: none
The motion passes.

Holtzman motions to amend the Rule of Order and Procedure so that Robert’s Rules
are used as a guideline for meetings.
Manning seconds the motion.

Ayes: Amirian, Bain, Kedikian, Manning, Masias, Michals, Molano, Nelson, Wolfson,
Finch, Wenz, Zakarian, Palos
Noes: none
Abstain: none
The motion passes.

  2
 Holtzman motions to amend the Rule of Order and Procedure as follows: (i) add that
regular meeting dates will be the 1st and 3rd Monday of each month; (ii) change the
expected completion date to the end of January, 2022; (iii) add that a majority of the
committee can request that City Council extend that date; (iv) add that the Executive
Committee shall be tasked with creating a list and schedule of deliverables to be
provided to the City Council and the public.
Amirian seconds the motion.

Ayes: Amirian, Bain, Kedikian, Manning, Masias, Michals, Molano, Nelson, Wolfson,
Finch, Wenz, Zakarian, Palos
Noes: none
Abstain: none

The committee members discuss the importance of giving committee members access
to materials outside of meetings. Holtzman, Molano, Bain and Wolfson support the idea
of creating a digital repository of information that committee members can access. The
committee members discuss potential topics for the next session, including reviewing
the Revised Rules of Order and Procedure, a financial presentation from Staff regarding
the City’s pension obligations, and a Brown Act presentation from the Garcia.
Garcia

6. REPORTS
  None

7. REQUESTS FOR ITEMS ON FUTURE AGENDAS
  None

8. ADJOURNMENT

Wolfson motion to adjourn
Seconded by Bains

Ayes: Amirian, Bain, Kedikian, Manning, Masias, Michals, Molano, Nelson, Wolfson,
Finch, Wenz, Zakarian, Palos
Noes: none
Abstain: none

The motion passes.

Meeting adjourns at 6:30pm.
